tokenGroups.name: Color roles
tokenGroups.description: Warm paper and ink roles with one cobalt accent and distinct gain and loss roles.
notes: Paper background, ink commands, cobalt for focus and emphasis. Gains read in success, losses in destructive, never in the accent.

tokens.name: Background
tokens.description: App canvas behind every surface.

tokenGroups.name: Typography roles
tokenGroups.description: Font families and functional type roles for text primitives.
notes: Serif for editorial titles and hero figures, grotesk for interface, mono for references. Money always uses tabular numerals.
